scope: Installed Linux ARM64 development archive with local PostgreSQL, actual Git and gVisor, and fixture GitHub authority
observations: The offline installer ran in an empty prefix and both installed binaries matched the archive member digests.
The real Git sandbox started at the imported commit, ran hard reset and index writes, and deliberately damaged the private Git config.
Capture rejected selection of .git/config and accepted the selected file against the original imported snapshot.
The same acceptance result was returned after workspace cleanup.
The separate file-placement phase recovered the same workspace after an injected acknowledgement failure.
